title: Squad International MP
description: Squad International MP is a modpack that aims to deliver better visuals, and making the gameplay smoother and overall better performance - at the same time, keeping it close to vanilla as possible!
body:
This modpack was built to make it easier for players to enjoy the vanilla experience with a more optimized and making the overall gameplay more refined.

Included are tools that should boost FPS, faster load times, and more grapichal settings so you can fine tune it to your liking

| Features |

Performance Optimization
 - Sodium and lithium is there to improve FPS and smoother chunk rendering
  
Visual Enhancments: 
- Lightning and particle upgrade, improved UI and better texture handling

Multiplayer Friendly:
- Almost all of the mods included are multiplayer friendly
- Servers are required to have simple voice chat plugin installed for the mod to work

No matter if you are exploring, building or just trying to survive with friends, Squad International MP brings you a upgraded feel to the typical vanilla experience.
The original intent of this modpack was towards our squad community, but it's really versatile, meaning it's open for everyone!
